Members

DOC_ROOTS

Publishable roots — root is the manifest namespace (also the docs URL prefix), dir the on-disk folder, label the display heading shown in the portal grid, kind the behavior class. skip is an optional top-level-only dir-name list excluded from that root's scan — used to keep already-published subtrees and heavy asset payloads out of a sibling root.

FORMAT_BY_EXT

Extension → portal format tag.

SKIP_DIRS

Directory entries never published, whatever the format. tests and per-module reports/coverage trees are reached through their own dedicated roots instead of leaking into a source bucket.

ILLEGAL_NAME

Entry names that can never be published: characters illegal in Windows filenames (* ? " < > | :) break git checkout on win32 clones, and ?/* inside a URL path segment corrupt query/glob semantics for crawlers. Typedoc renders ambient declare module '*.scss' shims as directories named after the glob pattern — those must be skipped.

MEDIA_INLINE_LIMIT

Largest media payload inlined as a data-URL (bytes on disk).

formatOf

Resolves a file extension to its format tag; unknown/binary shapes fall back to 'text' so every listed file still renders as readable HTML.

byDirThenName

Manifest ordering — dirs before files, then alphabetically by name. The same convention scanDir produces via its dirs/files split; used to re-order the concatenated children of merged case-collision dirs.

mergeCaseCollisions

Merges sibling nodes whose names collide case-insensitively — required because Windows checkouts live on case-insensitive NTFS, where App/ and app/ (typedoc emits both shapes for a module next to a folder) map to the same directory and each emitted index.html would overwrite the other. Colliding dirs keep the first-seen node and absorb the later dirs' children; colliding files keep the first and drop the rest. Recursion handles collisions introduced inside the merged children.
